```artifact
Feature: Appointment and Prescription Management

  Scenario Outline: Register and apply for Appointment/Consultation Request
    Given the patient is located in Pincode <pincode>
    When the patient registers and applies for an appointment/consultation request
    Then the request should be routed to the authorized chemist in the same Pincode

    Examples:
      | pincode |
      | 500001  |
      | 500002  |
      | 500003  |

  Scenario Outline: Prescription Request Routing
    Given the patient is located in Pincode <pincode>
    When the patient submits a prescription request
    Then the request should be routed to the authorized chemist in the same Pincode

    Examples:
      | pincode |
      | 500001  |
      | 500002  |
      | 500003  |

  Scenario Outline: Offline Delivery and Payment Collection
    Given the patient is located in Pincode <pincode>
    When the authorized chemist delivers the medicines and collects payment
    Then the prescription should be marked as completed

    Examples:
      | pincode |
      | 500001  |
      | 500002  |
      | 500003  |

  Scenario Outline: Negative Path - Invalid Pincode
    Given the patient is located in Pincode <pincode>
    When the patient registers and applies for an appointment/consultation request
    Then the request should not be routed and an error message should be displayed

    Examples:
      | pincode |
      | 500004  |
      | 500005  |
      | 500006  |

  Scenario Outline: Boundary Path - Edge Pincode
    Given the patient is located in Pincode <pincode>
    When the patient registers and applies for an appointment/consultation request
    Then the request should be routed to the authorized chemist in the same Pincode

    Examples:
      | pincode |
      | 500000  |
      | 500007  |
      | 500008  |
```
